newsitem.title: USA: Waste Technology Corp sees Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: Waste Technology Corp sees Q3 loss.

text.p: Waste Technology Corp said it expects to report a loss in its third quarter.

President and Chief Executive Ted Flood said in a statement that sluggish sales caused by a sharp drop in prices for recycled products are largely to blame for the projected loss in that quarter, which ends July 31.
However, he said that sales and earnings should "turn sharply higher" in the fourth quarter.
In the prior year's third quarter, the company reported net income of $7,000, or $0.00 per share, on sales of $3.82 million.
